questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 4, 6, 8, ?
questions.e: The series increases by 2 each time, so the next term is 8 + 2 = 10.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
questions.e: Each term is double the previous one, so the next term is 24 x 2 = 48.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, ?
questions.e: These are perfect squares (1, 2, 3, 4 squared), so the next is 5 squared = 25.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: A, C, E, G, ?
questions.e: The letters skip one each time (A, C, E, G), so the next letter is I.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 100, 90, 80, 70, ?
questions.e: The series decreases by 10 each time, so the next term is 60.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out?
questions.e: Apple, mango and banana are fruits; potato is a vegetable.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out?
questions.e: Python, Java and C++ are programming languages; Chrome is a web browser.

questions.q: Hand is to glove as foot is to what?
questions.e: A glove covers the hand, in the same way a sock covers the foot.

questions.q: Doctor is to hospital as teacher is to what?
questions.e: A doctor works in a hospital, and a teacher works in a school.

questions.q: Which number is the odd one out: 2, 3, 5, 9, 11?
questions.e: 2, 3, 5 and 11 are prime numbers. 9 is divisible by 3, so it is not prime.

questions.q: Ravi walks 5 km north and then 5 km south. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.e: The two movements are equal and opposite, so he ends at the starting point.

questions.q: A person facing east turns right. Which direction is the person facing now?
questions.e: Turning right from east means facing south.

questions.q: A is the brother of B, and B is the mother of C. How is A related to C?
questions.e: A is the brother of C's mother, so A is C's maternal uncle.

questions.q: In a row, Ravi is 4th from the left and 5th from the right. How many people are in the row?
questions.e: Total = 4 + 5 - 1 = 8, because Ravi is counted in both positions.

questions.q: If CAT is coded as DBU, what is the code for DOG?
questions.e: Each letter moves one place forward: D to E, O to P, G to H, giving EPH.

questions.q: All dogs are animals and all animals breathe. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.e: If all dogs are animals and all animals breathe, then all dogs breathe.

questions.q: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be the day after tomorrow?
questions.e: Tomorrow is Thursday, and the day after that is Friday.

questions.q: How many days are there in a leap year?
questions.e: A leap year has an extra day in February, making 366 days.

questions.q: All roses are flowers, and some flowers fade quickly. Can we conclude that all roses fade quickly?
questions.e: Only some flowers fade quickly, and the roses may not be among them, so the conclusion is not certain.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 5, 10, 15, 20, ?
questions.e: The series increases by 5 each time, so the next term is 25.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.e: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12 and the term is 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
questions.e: Each term is the sum of the two before it (Fibonacci): 5 + 8 = 13.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
questions.e: Each term is double the previous term plus 1: 47 x 2 + 1 = 95.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.e: The terms are n squared + 1 (1+1, 4+1, 9+1, ...), so the next is 36 + 1 = 37.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: AZ, BY, CX, ?
questions.e: The first letter moves forward and the second moves backward each time, giving DW.

questions.q: If TIGER is coded as UJHFS, what is the code for LION?
questions.e: Each letter is shifted one place forward: L to M, I to J, O to P, N to O.

questions.q: If A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on, what is the sum of the letter values in FACE?
Pointing to a man, Anil says, 'He is the son of my mother's only brother.' How is the man related to Anil?
questions.e: The man's father is Anil's maternal uncle, so the man is Anil's maternal cousin.

questions.q: A's father is B's son. How is B related to A?
questions.e: A's father is B's son, which makes B the father of A's father, i.e. A's grandfather.

questions.q: Ravi walks 10 m east, then 10 m south, then 10 m west. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
o: He is back at the start
questions.e: The east and west moves cancel out, leaving a net movement of 10 m south.

questions.q: A person walks 3 km north and then 4 km east. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.e: The path forms a right triangle with sides 3 and 4, so the hypotenuse is 5 km.

questions.q: In a class of 40, Meena ranks 12th from the top. What is her rank from the bottom?
questions.e: Rank from bottom = 40 - 12 + 1 = 29.

questions.q: All engineers are graduates. Some graduates are artists. Conclusions: I. Some engineers are artists. II. Some artists are graduates. Which follows?
questions.e: Conclusion II is the converse of a given statement and must be true. Conclusion I is not guaranteed because the artists may be different graduates.

questions.q: No cat is a dog. All dogs are animals. Conclusions: I. No dog is a cat. II. Some animals are not cats. Which follows?
questions.e: I is the converse of the first statement. Since dogs are animals and no dog is a cat, some animals (the dogs) are not cats, so II also follows.

questions.q: If the 5th of a month is a Monday, which day is the 26th of the same month?
questions.e: 26 - 5 = 21 days later, which is exactly 3 weeks, so it is also a Monday.

questions.q: A father is 3 times as old as his son. After 12 years he will be twice as old as his son. What is the son's present age?
questions.e: Let the son be x. Then 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12), which gives x = 12.

questions.q: Four friends S, P, Q and R stand in a line in that order from left to right. Who is second from the right?
questions.e: From the right the order is R, Q, P, S, so Q is second from the right.

questions.q: Which number is the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125?
questions.e: 8, 27, 64 and 125 are perfect cubes. 100 is not a cube.

questions.q: 3 is to 27 as 4 is to what?
questions.e: 27 is 3 cubed, so the answer is 4 cubed = 64.

questions.q: ACE is to BDF as GIK is to what?
questions.e: Each letter moves one place forward: G to H, I to J, K to L.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out?
questions.e: Printer, scanner and keyboard are hardware devices. A compiler is software.

questions.q: A pen costs 5 more than a pencil. Together they cost 25. What is the cost of the pencil?
questions.e: Let the pencil cost x. Then x + (x + 5) = 25, so x = 10.

questions.q: The rule is: 'All managers attend the weekly meeting.' Raj did not attend the weekly meeting. What must be true?
questions.e: If every manager attends, anyone who did not attend cannot be a manager.

questions.q: 1 January 2023 was a Sunday. What day was 1 January 2024?
questions.e: 2023 is not a leap year, so it has 365 days, which is 52 weeks and 1 day. The day moves forward by one, to Monday.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand at exactly 3:00?
questions.e: At 3:00 the minute hand is on 12 and the hour hand is on 3, a quarter of the dial, which is 90 degrees.

questions.q: Some pens are books. All books are pencils. Conclusions: I. Some pens are pencils. II. All pens are pencils. Which follows?
questions.e: The pens that are books are also pencils, so some pens are pencils. Nothing says every pen is a book, so II does not follow.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
questions.e: Each term is double the previous plus 1: 63 x 2 + 1 = 127.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
questions.e: These are consecutive prime numbers, and the next prime after 13 is 17.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ?
questions.e: Each term is the previous multiplied by 2, 3, 4, 5 and then 6: 120 x 6 = 720.

questions.q: What comes next in the series: 4, 6, 9, 13, 18, ?
questions.e: The differences are 2, 3, 4, 5, so the next difference is 6 and the term is 24.

questions.q: A says 'B is a liar.' B says 'A and I are both honest.' Assuming each person is either always honest or always lying, who is honest?
o: A is honest and B is a liar
B is honest and A is a liar
questions.e: If A were lying, B would be honest, but then B's claim that A is honest would be false, a contradiction. So A is honest and B is lying.

questions.q: A man walks 6 km north, turns right and walks 8 km, then turns right again and walks 6 km. Where is he relative to the starting point?
questions.e: North 6, east 8, south 6 leaves him at the same north-south position and 8 km to the east.

questions.q: In a row of 31 students, Gita is 9th from the left and Hari is 12th from the right. How many students are between them?
questions.e: Hari's position from the left is 31 - 12 + 1 = 20. Students between = 20 - 9 - 1 = 10.

questions.q: The ages of A and B are in the ratio 3:5. After 6 years the ratio will be 2:3. What is A's present age?
questions.e: Let ages be 3x and 5x. Then (3x + 6)/(5x + 6) = 2/3 gives x = 6, so A is 18.

questions.q: What is the smaller angle between the hour hand and the minute hand at 3:30?
questions.e: At 3:30 the hour hand is at 105 degrees and the minute hand at 180 degrees, a difference of 75 degrees.

questions.q: Some A are B. All B are C. No C is D. Conclusions: I. Some A are C. II. Some A are not D. III. No B is D. Which follow?
o: All of I, II and III
questions.e: Those A that are B are also C, so I follows. Since no C is D, those A are not D, so II follows. All B are C and no C is D, so III follows.

questions.q: Statement: A company announces that all employees must use two-factor login from next month. Which assumption is implicit?
o: The company wants to improve account security
All employees own the latest smartphone
Passwords will no longer be needed
questions.e: Making a new login step mandatory implies the company believes it improves security. The other statements are not required by the announcement.

questions.q: A is B's sister, C is B's mother, D is C's father, and E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.e: C is also A's mother, and D is C's father, so D is A's grandfather and A is D's granddaughter.

questions.q: If MOUSE is coded as PRXVH, what is the code for LAMP?
questions.e: Each letter is shifted three places forward: L to O, A to D, M to P, P to S.

questions.q: At a meeting, each of 8 people shakes hands exactly once with every other person. How many handshakes take place?
questions.e: The number of pairs is 8 x 7 / 2 = 28.

questions.q: What is the minimum number of people needed to be sure that at least two of them were born in the same month?
questions.e: There are 12 months, so by the pigeonhole principle 13 people guarantee a repeated month.
